topic.angle: Hyperinflation: prices doubling in about 15 hours

body.question: At one stage of Hungary's pengő hyperinflation, about how many hours did it take for prices to double?
body.reveal: About 15 hours. At one stage it took only about 15 hours for prices to double and about four days for the pengő to lose 90% of its prior value. The forint replaced the pengő on 1 August 1946, dropping 29 zeroes.

probes.question: Which currency replaced the pengő in 1946?
How many zeroes did the forint drop from the old currency?

image_brief.show: A huge-denomination pengő banknote (b.-pengő or milpengő)

claims.claim: At one stage it took only about 15 hours for prices to double (question, answer 15, reveal)
claims.quote: The hyperinflation was so out of control that at one stage it took only about 15 hours for prices to double

claims.claim: About four days for the pengő to lose 90% of its prior value
claims.quote: about four days for the pengő to lose 90% of its prior value
On 1 August 1946, Hungary reintroduced the forint at a ratio of 400 octillion pengős to 1

claims.claim: Forint dropped 29 zeroes from the old currency (probe 2 answer 29)
claims.quote: dropping 29 zeroes from the old currency, or 200 000 000 adópengős to 1.

claims.claim: Pengő was replaced by the forint in 1946 (probe 1 answer Forint)
